row_outcome_contract.coverage_numerator: distinct ledger keys with an allowed outcome

FULL.meaning: metadata, binary payload, binding, checksum, storage ownership and effective ACL are present and verified in target storage on one freeze watermark
FULL.common_snapshot_invariant: db_snapshot_id and upload_snapshot_id are signed against the same freeze_watermark

PARTIAL.meaning: metadata and available bindings/ACL evidence migrate; every missing binary or unresolved ACL is explicitly unavailable

historical_actor_semantics.valid_from: source event or entity creation timestamp
historical_actor_semantics.valid_to: null unless the source explicitly periods the historical role

actor_assignment_contract.source_actor_resolution: source user is always preserved as identity.legacy_actor; eligible staff may additionally resolve to identity.employee_profile

file_acl_contract.acl_reconciliation_cardinality: every source ACL/share row has exactly one target ACL or signed conflict outcome

custom_field_quarantine_contract.raw_value_storage: restricted encrypted quarantine only; never generated artifacts, stdout, logs or reconciliation samples
custom_field_quarantine_contract.row_ledger_semantics: field quarantine is a sidecar outcome and does not create a second row-level migration outcome

signature_contract.signed_payload: canonical_json(source_table, source_key, source_owner_id, decision_outcome, new_operational_owner_id, rule_version, decided_by, decided_at)

case_history.interval_rule: START_DATE <= END_DATE for every mapped row

task_history_contract.missing_user_reference_semantics: system_connector for UF_CRM_TASK_ADDED/DELETED events; never invent employee identity
